about: Erin is a town in Wellington County, Ontario, in the Hills of Headwaters between Orangeville and Guelph, covering Erin village, Hillsburgh, and surrounding countryside. Rolling farmland, the West Credit River, and a small-town Main Street define a rural municipality often mistaken for only its namesake village. About 12,000 people live in Erin.
